claim: Every singular-DP history from a 42-variable 44-clause pure signed 4-CNF Ramsey extension obstruction to a terminal F_p obeys an exact clause-excess contraction budget. After a first disjoint 3+3 fan of arity m, the remaining steps have total charge 90+2m-2p and some remaining step has charge at least ceil(2+(2m+8)/(41-p)), hence at least 3.
collision_guard: Kullmann-Zhao Lemma 3(a)-(c) gives the full set-CNF guard: every main/side pair is resolvable only on the pivot, the m resolvents are pairwise distinct, and none equals an unaffected clause. Thus standard DP, with no subsumption-minimization pass, replaces m+1 pivot clauses by exactly m new non-tautological clauses. Deficiency preservation alone is not used to prove collision-freedom.
scope: A necessary condition on every complete singular-DP ancestry of a hypothetical 44-clause obstruction. It does not assert that the charge condition is sufficient and does not by itself exclude all histories.
